title: Count down from 5 to 1
description: Use a while loop to print 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. Then print Go!
solution:
number = 3
while number > 0:
    print(number)
    number -= 1
print("Go!")

title: Add numbers 1 to 5 with while
description: Use a while loop to add the numbers from 1 to 5. Print the total.
solution:
total = 0
number = 1
while number <= 4:
    total += number
    number += 1
print(total)

title: Count the digits in 12345
description: Use a while loop to count the digits in 12345. Print how many digits it has.
solution:
number = 5821
count = 0
while number > 0:
    count += 1
    number //= 10
print(count)
